description: Provisioned versus realized capacity per deployment, with p95 heap and disk utilization and the resulting wasted spend. This is the single best tool for finding over-provisioned Hosted deployments. Rows where utilization_data_missing is true have no node_stats, so utilization defaults to 100% and waste cannot be measured - that is expected for Serverless projects, which auto-scale.

configuration.query:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_realized_pool
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND data_tier_capacity_ecu IS NOT NULL
| EVAL billing_ts = @timestamp, ck = composite_key::keyword, billing_deployment_id = deployment_id, billing_deployment_name = deployment_name, bill_is_onprem = COALESCE(is_onprem, false)
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", billing_ts, NOW()) <= ?days
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| EVAL ts = billing_ts, cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, c_mem_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_memory_weight), c_disk_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_storage_weight), c_util_floor = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_floor)
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(bill_is_onprem, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), currency_unit = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_unit, "EUR"), COALESCE(cloud_unit, "EUR")), mem_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_memory_weight), c_mem_w, 70.0), COALESCE(c_mem_w, 70.0)), disk_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_storage_weight), c_disk_w, 30.0), COALESCE(c_disk_w, 30.0)), util_floor = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_floor), c_util_floor, 0.10), COALESCE(c_util_floor, 0.10))
| EVAL heap_util = COALESCE(heap_used_pct_p95, 100.0) / 100.0, disk_util = COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, 100.0) / 100.0
| EVAL raw_utilization_score = CASE(mem_w + disk_w > 0.0, (mem_w * heap_util + disk_w * disk_util) / (mem_w + disk_w), 1.0)
| EVAL utilization_score = CASE(raw_utilization_score < util_floor, util_floor, raw_utilization_score)
| EVAL chargeable_pool = data_tier_capacity_ecu * COALESCE(utilization_score, 1.0)
| EVAL provisioned_cost = data_tier_capacity_ecu * rate, realized_cost = chargeable_pool * rate
| EVAL utilization_data_missing = heap_used_pct_p95 IS NULL AND disk_used_pct_p95 IS NULL
| STATS provisioned_cost = SUM(provisioned_cost), realized_cost = SUM(realized_cost), currency = VALUES(currency_unit), avg_heap_pct = AVG(heap_used_pct_p95), avg_disk_pct = AVG(disk_used_pct_p95), no_utilization_data = MAX(utilization_data_missing)
    BY deployment_id = billing_deployment_id, deployment_name = billing_deployment_name
| EVAL wasted_cost = provisioned_cost - realized_cost
| SORT wasted_cost DESC
| LIMIT 50
